description.en: Lifespan chronicle for DSH: weaves deliveries, experiences, stretch summaries and warmth-ranked upstream memories into one timeline, injecting state/recents/recalled plus one warm line before each model step. Not a fact memory store - this is the fish's life.
description.zh: DSH 生平编年插件：把事（交付）、感（体验）、线（里程碑）、得知与「关于这个人」编到同一条时间轴上并带温度；模型步骤前注入此刻状态、刚发生的、被勾起的回忆与一条暖记忆。不是事实记忆库，是这条鱼的生平。
